summary: Greenpro Capital Corp. filed an 8-K regarding a confidential settlement agreement with Millennium Fine Art Inc. (MFAI) to resolve litigation and arbitration over a 2021 NFT-related contract. Greenpro will pay $100,000 and surrender 2,000,000 restricted shares of MFAI Class B common stock (its entire equity interest in MFAI, representing ~5% of MFAI's outstanding shares and ~1% of voting rights) for cancellation. The board approved unanimously. The settlement includes mutual releases and dismissal with prejudice. This is a legal settlement, not a special-situations corporate transaction.
